svg.title: Conservation Officer / BC Environment — small 1992 source edition
svg.desc: Clean vector reconstruction from visible artifact references; no photograph tracing, source textures or embedded raster. Natural outlined replacement fonts approximate embroidered alphabets. Exact stitch anatomy, manufacturing dimensions and calibrated thread colors remain unverified. Whole-master source placement uses uniform scale; the photograph is not used to distort separate border or emblem components. The tiny flag beside BC is a clean symbolic reconstruction; fine embroidered flag details are unresolved.
